name: keyport

scripts.dev: bun run build && bunx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && bunx wrangler deploy --keep-vars
scripts.db:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local

DB.description: Account profiles, encrypted connections, and 90-day audit records. The keyport build token needs Account D1 Edit permission to apply migrations.

description: A self-hosted Tailscale auth key desk on Cloudflare.
